en: Bowing my head to Lord Vishnu, the master of the three worlds, I will set out a collection of wise rules for rulers, drawn from many sacred books.
A good person who studies this in the proper way comes to know what duty teaches, what should and should not be done, and what is good and what is bad.
So, wishing for the good of all people, I will explain it; just by understanding it, one gains a wide knowledge of life.
Even a wise person comes to grief by teaching a foolish pupil, by supporting a wicked woman, and by keeping close company with the miserable.

first: दुष्टा भार्या शठं मित्रं भृत्यश् चोत्तरदायकः ।
en: A wicked wife, a false friend, a servant who talks back, and living in a house with a snake: these are death itself, without doubt.
Save money for hard times; protect your wife even at the cost of money; but always protect yourself, even at the cost of wife and money.
Save money for hard times. If you ask what trouble a rich man can have, know that fortune is fickle; even wealth piled up can be lost one day.

first: यस्मिन् देशे न सम्मानो न वृत्तिर्न च बान्धवः ।
en: Do not live in a place where you get no respect, no means of living, no relatives, and no chance to learn.

first: धनिकः श्रोत्रियो राजा नदी वैद्यस्तु पञ्चमः ।
en: Do not stay even one day where these five are missing: a rich man, a learned priest, a king, a river, and a doctor.
Do not make your home among people who lack these five: a way to earn a living, fear of wrong, a sense of shame, kindness, and a giving nature.
Test servants when you send them on a task, relatives when trouble comes, a friend in danger, and a wife when wealth is lost.
The one who stands by you in sickness, in misfortune, in famine, when enemies attack, at the king's court, and at the cremation ground is your true relative.
One who leaves what is certain and runs after what is uncertain loses what was certain, and the uncertain is lost anyway.
A wise man should marry a girl of a good family even if she is plain, rather than a beautiful one from a low family; marriage is best between equals.
Never put your trust in rivers, in men who carry weapons, in animals with claws or horns, in women, or in royal families.

first: विषाद् अप्य् अमृतं ग्राह्यम् अमेध्याद् अपि काञ्चनम् ।
en: Take nectar even from poison, gold even from filth, the best knowledge even from a lowly person, and a fine wife even from a humble family.

first: स्त्रीणां द्विगुण आहारो लज्जा चापि चतुर्गणा ।
en: It is said that women have twice the appetite of men, four times the shyness, six times the daring, and eight times the desire.
